name: Kaichou Dairi ni Rei!
source:
Meet protagonist Minami Yuuta, high school freshman. He's normal in every way, and so is his life. 
One day, he gets selected to be class president, and has to oversee the upcoming festival... 
How will things pan out for Yuuta? 

A voiced, perky teenage BL game! Help Yuuta succeed in love and responsibility. 
7 possible endings. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE041669.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
认识主人公南悠太，一名高中一年级新生。他在各方面都很普通，生活也是如此。一天，他被选为班长，必须监督即将到来的校园文化节……悠太的结果会怎样？

一款全语音、活泼的青春BL游戏！帮助悠太在恋爱和责任上取得成功。7种可能的结局。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE041669.html]DLsite English[/url]]
